profile.headline: Virginia Tech Alumni/Software Developer
profile.summary:
Underwent a rigorous training at Revature, where I learned to become a Full Stack .Net Developer, and have exceled in topics relating to C#, SQL, Angular, and DevOps related work such as using technologies like Git and Azure

Knowing how to code in C, Java, Python, MATLAB, and R, I have put skills to the test as the Webmaster of the executive board for the club known as Latin Link. After being influenced by American and Hispanic culture, I’ve been able to communicate people who are both English and Spanish speakers. Thanks to my experience in hospitality and the restaurant business, I’ve gained the knowledge and confidence to make a great first impression to anyone, a first impression that matches with my ambition to succeed in the real world.
